lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，看得也不差。
lines.en: I have only one eye, and it serves me.

lines.zh: 我踏过沙地，土在脚下散。
lines.en: I cross the sand and the ground scatters.

lines.zh: 我歪着走，独眼却一直朝前。
lines.en: I walk crooked, but my single eye stays ahead.
My body is off balance, so I walk crooked.
I walk around the rocks.
One of my arms is longer than the other.
A few strides carry me over a shallow ditch.
I head for the warm ground.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，独眼转了转。
lines.en: I shake my head and my eye rolls.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下很深的印。
lines.en: I leave deep prints in the sand.

lines.zh: 我歪着身子，一步一步蹭过沙。
lines.en: I lean and shuffle across the sand one step at a time.
I head for the pass again.
There's an old mark on my chest.

lines.zh: 我停住，独眼朝山口抬起。
lines.en: I stop and lift my single eye toward the pass.
I stand still, my single eye watching.
Sand blows into my face.
I prop myself on the longer arm.
I'm listening to the mountain.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，看得却远。
lines.en: One eye, and it sees far.

lines.zh: 我用长臂撑着，磨了磨牙。
lines.en: I brace on my long arm and grind my teeth.
The heat haze shifts here.
My one eye rolls slowly.
I lean my body against the stone.
I can see smoke far off.
I blink that one eye slowly.
My shadow is smaller than I look.

lines.zh: 独眼一直看着，等个对手。
lines.en: My one eye watches, waiting for a rival.
I score a line in the ground.
One eye is enough to see you.
You stand steadier than I expected.

lines.zh: 我的独眼凑到你面前，一眨不眨。
lines.en: My single eye comes close to your face, unblinking.
No iron smell on you. Strange.

lines.zh: 近得我能数清你的手指。
lines.en: Close enough to count your fingers.

lines.zh: 别动，我一只眼正对着你。
lines.en: Don't move; my one eye is fixed on you.
When your hand comes up, I'll move.
This eye of mine doesn't blink.
One eye, and it sees you.

lines.zh: 我的独眼把你整个人收进去了。
lines.en: My single eye has taken all of you in.
What do you plan to do?
A stretch of sand lies between us.
I've raised my longer arm.

lines.zh: 你那道旧伤，我一只眼就看清。
lines.en: With my one eye I can see that old wound of yours.
There's only us on this road.
My long arm hangs at my side.
The sand slips and I lurch half a step.
I give half a step.

lines.zh: 一只眼盯你，剩下的看路。
lines.en: One eye on you, the rest on the road.
I take a breath.
I press my chest.

lines.zh: 我皮上开了口子，沙一盖就止。
lines.en: The hide is split; packing sand in stops the bleed.
A scale has split.

lines.zh: 我一只脚陷进沙里，又站稳。
lines.en: One foot sinks into the sand; I steady myself again.
I've kept that angle.
This isn't over.
The smell of meat rides the wind.
I reach for it.

lines.zh: 这点肉，我的独眼都嫌少。
lines.en: My one eye finds even this too little meat.
Set the meat on the ground.
On the sand I chew with a loud crunch.
Is there a second piece?
One hand is enough.
This meat tastes decent.

lines.zh: 我把最后一口肉慢慢咽下。
lines.en: I swallow the last bite slowly.

lines.zh: 手别伸，我的牙比沙暴快。
lines.en: Keep your hand back; my teeth are quicker than a sandstorm.

lines.zh: 我舔掉牙缝里的沙，又看你。
lines.en: I lick the sand from my teeth and look at you again.
This makes me a little hot.
You hit my arm.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的皮，硬得像岩。
lines.en: You hit my hide, hard as rock.
You bounced back a step.

lines.zh: 你撞上我的臂，我一步也没退。
lines.en: You hit my arm and I did not give a step.
My foot slips and I recover.
My eye is still on you.
My hide is harder than the sand.

lines.zh: 你挡在我长臂的落点上。
lines.en: You are standing where my long arm lands.
I twist aside.
Keep going; don't stop.
I've seen my kind in these mountains.
It also had only one eye.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此走，独眼一直没眨。
lines.en: We circle each other; my single eye never blinks.
Neither struck first.
Then we sat down together.
Sand blew between us the whole time.
With one eye, I see only one way.
We watched the distance a long while.
Then we went our separate ways.
I'm still in this country.
I grab with my longer arm.

lines.zh: 我用长的那只手把它搂住。
lines.en: I scoop it up with my longer arm.
That's too heavy for this arm.

lines.zh: 独眼的兽，一只眼也够看。
lines.en: One eye is enough for this beast.
It slid into the sand.
I dig it out.
This can wear down my teeth.
I drop it back.
Can you carry it?
I don't need this thing.

lines.zh: 沙面一鼓，我的独眼就锁上了。
lines.en: The sand bulges and my one eye locks on.
My eye caught it.

lines.zh: 独眼对上了，我不再挪眼。
lines.en: My single eye lines up and I stop moving it.
I shuffle toward it.
It doesn't reach my knee.
I raise my long arm.
The sand here is soft.
It stood there and didn't retreat.

lines.zh: 独眼对准了，架势也摆好。
lines.en: One eye fixed, stance set.
Only one eye, and the aim is true.
My throat is heating.
It lunges at me.

lines.zh: 我拖着步子，围着它兜半圈。
lines.en: I drag my feet in a half circle around it.
My eye doesn't leave it.
It's backed to the rocks.
I step across.
I reach with my long arm.
It sidestepped away.

lines.zh: 独眼一转，我换了个方向。
lines.en: My single eye shifts and I change direction.
The sand is slowing my feet.

lines.zh: 我把长臂收拢，伏到沙上。
lines.en: I gather my long arm and drop flat to the sand.

lines.zh: 它一抬手，我把长臂收回来。
lines.en: It raises a hand and I pull my long arm back.
I duck my head aside.
This time I must grab it.
I whip down with my long arm.
I bite its arm.
It rolls away from the impact.
I lost my footing.
I spit out something hot.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，这一下没抓住。
lines.en: I have only one eye, and this time I missed.

lines.zh: 长臂一抡，我把它甩进沙里。
lines.en: My long arm swings and flings it into the sand.
It struck my chest.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，也看得准。
lines.en: One eye, and it's accurate.
I draw my long arm back.
Its blood is on the sand.
My one eye is still fixed.
I walk out of the pass.
My single eye adjusts to the light first.
This sand is very dry.
I raise my longer arm.

lines.zh: 我只有一只眼，看得很清楚。
lines.en: I have one eye, and it sees clearly.
I look toward the smoke.
I walk toward the sand.
My steps are unsteady.
My roar rolls through the mountain.
The mountain sends it back.

lines.zh: 我从山口出来，沙还在往身上落。
lines.en: I come out of the pass with sand still falling on me.

lines.zh: 我从沙丘后站起，独眼发亮。
lines.en: I rise from behind the dune, my single eye bright.
I raise a hand against the sun.

lines.zh: 我越过山口，朝更高处挪。
lines.en: I cross the pass and shuffle higher.
The flames tighten my hide.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，磕了好几下。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, striking stones.

lines.zh: 水灌进我的独眼，我拼命挣。
lines.en: Water floods my one eye and I thrash.
The blast throws me onto the rocks.

lines.zh: 箭钉在我的臂上，扎得很深。
lines.en: An arrow sticks deep in my arm.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的独眼一阵花。
lines.en: That light blinds my one eye for a moment.

lines.zh: 饿了太久，我抬不起手臂。
lines.en: Too long hungry, and I can't raise my arm.

lines.zh: 雷劈在沙上，我独眼一花。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the sand and my single eye whites out.
The ledge crumbles and I tumble down.
